# Computer-Use Automation System (CUA)
> Deterministic Execution Engine for Regulated Banking Applications.
> Core thesis: an LLM is allowed to be uncertain exactly once; the run it produces is
> compiled into a typed artifact that replays with no model in the loop.

## Summary
CUA is an enterprise computer-use automation system engineered for regulated financial back-offices (banks and credit unions). An LLM is permitted to explore an arbitrary legacy application with no API exactly once. That exploration trace is compiled into an immutable, typed, content-hashed Capability Artifact. All subsequent runs execute deterministically with zero model calls in the loop.

- Full Documentation: https://adityamhaske.github.io/computer-use-automation/docs/index.html
- Complete Single-File Context: https://adityamhaske.github.io/computer-use-automation/llms-full.txt
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/adityamhaske/computer-use-automation

## The 10 Invariants
1. Replay never calls or imports the LLM: Replay is purely deterministic with 0 model calls.
2. No action reaches a driver without policy authorization: Action -> TargetResolver -> PolicyEngine -> SurfaceDriver.
3. Target identity is a semantic TargetDescriptor: Uses accessible names and structural anchors, never brittle CSS/XPath.
4. Human input cannot bypass policy or evidence: Operator input goes through the same chokepoint and evidence logger.
5. Unknown states fail closed: Undeclared screens trigger UNEXPECTED_STATE and immediate human handoff.
6. Every sink is redacted: Secrets and PII are redacted from logs, records, screenshots, and prompts.
7. Business outcomes are not failures: 'member_not_found' is a valid business return, not a defect.
8. Automation may only act while it holds the session: Leases and epochs prevent collisions with human operators.
9. Capabilities are immutable: Versioned, frozen, and SHA-256 content-hashed.
10. domain/ is pure: Zero I/O, zero network, zero browser dependencies.

## Architecture Pipeline
1. Goal + Surface Target: What to accomplish in an application with no API.
2. LLM Discovery: Agent explores live UI once; captures trace.
3. Capability Artifact: Trace compiled into typed, sealed, immutable artifact.
4. Deterministic Replay: 100% deterministic re-execution; 0 models.
5. Typed Audit Output: Complete audit trail, structured outputs, evidence files.

- [Fault & Test Matrix](https://adityamhaske.github.io/computer-use-automation/docs/index.html#test_matrix): Offline test suite and fault injection verification.

## Unified CLI Commands
```bash
./start.sh                 # Default: setup venv + run the full 14-stage demo
./start.sh ui              # Launch HITL Web Console (:8812) + Mock Bank (:8811)
./start.sh check           # Run CI checks: lint + strict typecheck + invariants + tests
./start.sh test            # Run offline test suite (0 API keys, 0 network)
cua replay <artifact>      # Replay a compiled capability deterministically
```
